# Kroozers Tire & Automotive

> Kroozers Tire & Automotive is an Amarillo, Texas tire and auto repair shop owned by Max Albright, in business since 1992, offering tires, alignment, brakes and major mechanical repairs.

## Key facts
- Business: Kroozers Tire & Automotive
- Owner: Max Albright
- Location: 3228 Commerce St, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Specialties: tire sales & install, all-wheel alignment, brake service, oil, filter & lube, shocks & struts, major repairs
- Rating: 4.8 stars from 145 Google reviews
- In business since: 1992
- Phone: (806) 354-9688
- Address: 3228 Commerce St, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Hours: Mon – Fri 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM; Sat – Sun Closed
- Services: Tire Sales & Install, All-Wheel Alignment, Brake Service, Oil, Filter & Lube, Shocks & Struts, Major Repairs
